subject: Founder plan: 12–24m prepay structure & credits
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Chen <sophia@fastscale.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Founder plan: 12–24m prepay structure & credits

Hi Sophia — great talking earlier. Per our chat I put together two compact options for FastScale's founder plan: a 12‑month prepay and an optional 24‑month term with additional term discount. High level:  

- Option A (12 months): $50,000 prepay up front, includes $5k onboarding credit and 3 months of priority support. Ramped minimums: first 3 months at 30% committed usage, ramp to target (100% of expected monthly usage) by month 4. Monthly true‑up at quarter end.
- Option B (24 months): $90,000 prepay up front (equivalent to a modest committed discount); we can offer an additional 10% term discount applied to MSRP compared to the 12m pricing, and increase onboarding credit to $7k. Ramped minimums can be smoothed across the first 6 months.

I attached a simple pricing grid (redwood_pricing_grid.xlsx) and included a short SOW stub for clarity on onboarding scope. If you want we can also structure credits as token‑based or dollars to be consumed against overages.

Questions for you: which option feels closer to your runway planning? If you prefer 12m, would a larger onboarding credit or a 2‑month free ramp window (additional credit) make the economics workable?

Next steps: if you indicate a preferred option I’ll loop in finance and Aditya for final signoff and we’ll produce a DocuSign for signatures.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0198

Aditya / Neha — forwarding FastScale conversation (see below). Founder‑stage startup, short runway but strong product fit for our Small Startups playbook. They asked for a meaningful onboarding credit and flexible ramping.

My suggested leaning: lead with 12m, $50k prepay + $5k onboarding credit and a 3‑month ramp (30% floor -> 100% target by month 4). If they commit to 18 months we can convert to the 24m term discount (extra 10%) or offer an additional 5% on year‑one invoice.

Ask: can we approve up to an additional 5% commercial concession or an extra $2k credit at AE discretion? Also need confirmation on whether finance wants the 18m conversion clause to be in scope or if legal should handle.

Attaching pricing grid for quick reference.

— Jordan

- Approve Option A as primary: 12m, $50k prepay, $5k onboarding credit.
- Approve an additional AE concession: up to $2k one‑time credit (i.e., total onboarding credit $7k) without escalation.

Jordan — thanks, this looks promising. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Ramp minimums — can you put explicit month buckets in the SOW? We’d like: m1=30%, m2=50%, m3=70%, m4+ = target usage. We need to understand how true‑ups will be invoiced (monthly vs quarterly).
2) Credits — the onboarding credit is important. Can that be applied to consulting/training line items as well as overage?
3) Support credits — we’d like 3 months of priority support turned into a $$ credit that can be used for PS hours if needed.
4) Unused prepay — would Redwood consider converting unused prepay balance to platform credits valid for 12 months?

If you can reflect the above in SOW + provide a DocuSign link we can get signatures this week. Ben and I are aligned but need legal to greenlight the conversion language.

Appreciate the flexibility — Sophia

Thanks Sophia — happy to confirm. Agreed points below (I’ll put them in the SOW and send for signatures):

- Base offer: 12m prepay $50,000 paid up front. Onboarding credit: $7,000 (includes $5k standard + $2k AE concession approved by Aditya).
- Ramp schedule in SOW: m1=30%, m2=50%, m3=70%, m4+ = target usage. Quarterly true‑up language (invoice at quarter end for over/under usage).
- Support credit: 3 months of priority support converted to a $3,000 credit that can be used against PS hours or support overages.
- Unused prepay: we will allow conversion of remaining prepay balance to Redwood platform credits valid for 12 months, limited to one conversion event and subject to review (Legal to finalize exact wording).

Next steps: I’ll attach the SOW stub (FS_SOW_v1.pdf) and push a DocuSign envelope (link included). Please confirm final billing contact and PO details so Finance can issue the invoice when the DocuSign is complete. I’ll update HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FS-2026-047
